verifications.claim: Lockheed Martin built the Orion crew capsule for Artemis II.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Built by Lockheed Martin, Orion'; R4: 'Orion: Lockheed Martin'; R5: 'Lockheed Martin... development of the Orion spacecraft — including the crew capsule'; R6: 'Lockheed Martin is the prime contractor building Orion'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly attribute Orion spacecraft/crew capsule construction to Lockheed Martin.

verifications.claim: European Space Agency (ESA) and Airbus manufactured the European Service Module (ESM).

verifications.evidence: R3: 'service module—built by a European consortium led by Airbus'; R4: 'ESM: Airbus'; R8: 'The ESM is built by Airbus on behalf of the European Space Agency (ESA)'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Airbus built ESM for/on behalf of ESA.

verifications.claim: European Service Module (ESM) provides power and propulsion.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'provides propulsion, thermal control, electrical power'; R8: 'provide propulsion, power'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements confirm ESM provides power and propulsion.

verifications.claim: Lockheed Martin built the Launch Abort System.
